projects.title: ASCII / Binary Visual Deconstruction Engine
projects.summary: Standalone TypeScript library running live in the background of this portfolio: progressively transforms live video or images across 5 continuous stages (RAW, Drift, Particle, Hybrid, and Binary) at 60 FPS.
projects.context: Open-source on GitHub and executing live behind this page — try any local image via Alt + I.
projects.imageAlt: 5-panel showcase of the visual deconstruction engine stages: 01 RAW, 02 DRIFT, 03 PARTICLE, 04 HYBRID, and 05 BINARY
projects.challenge: Render thousands of glyphs per frame synchronized to continuous scroll and scene motion without frame drops, garbage-collection spikes, or compromising editorial legibility.
decisions: Offscreen downsampling proportional to the active stage cell size, dramatically cutting pixel readback overhead per frame.
Reusable Uint32Array framebuffer with a sparse pre-rendered glyph stamp cache and typed particle pool, eliminating per-frame fillText calls and allocations.
Packaged as a zero-dependency ESM library with TypeScript definitions (.d.ts), procedural fallback, and an interactive demo.

projects.title: HorarioProfs — School Schedule Organizer
projects.stackSummary: React 19 · Electron · Tailwind v4 · PDF / CSV
projects.summary: Web and desktop application for building school timetables across multiple teachers, classes, and availability constraints — eliminating scheduling conflicts and minimizing teacher gaps.
projects.context: Private repository — get in touch if you would like to learn more about this project or see a live walkthrough.
projects.imageAlt: HorarioProfs interface displaying an automated conflict-free class schedule with PDF export
projects.challenge: Building school timetables manually across dozens of classes, subjects, and individual teacher availability windows takes days for coordinators and often introduces clashes and idle gaps.
decisions: Unified management of teachers, classes, curricula, and availability windows in a guided flow with continuous conflict validation.
Combines assisted timetable generation with direct slot-swap manual editing, per-teacher views, saved schedule versions, and a diagnostics panel.
Dual delivery (web and Electron desktop app) with local persistence, CSV import/export, and landscape-ready PDF printing.

projects.title: GoodHamburguer — .NET API & Blazor Operations
projects.stackSummary: .NET 10 · C# · Blazor Server · MySQL · Docker · Testcontainers
projects.summary: Full-stack order and menu management system built with Clean Architecture + DDD, featuring a versioned REST API (/api/v1), Blazor Server operations UI, observability, Docker Compose, and real MySQL integration tests.
projects.context: Public repository with a reproducible Docker Compose setup and automated GitHub Actions CI pipeline.
projects.imageAlt: GoodHamburguer operational dashboard in Blazor Server connected to the v1 REST API
projects.challenge: Architect an end-to-end .NET application ready for technical review — combining isolated domain rules, real relational persistence, queryable operational logs, and a 100% reproducible environment.
decisions: Pragmatic Clean Architecture + DDD separating Domain, Application, Infrastructure (EF Core + MySQL), versioned HTTP contracts with ProblemDetails, and a Blazor Server frontend.
Database-backed operational logging middleware, liveness/readiness health checks, Serilog, and OpenTelemetry for end-to-end observability.
Orchestrated Docker Compose stack (MySQL, migrations/seed, API, and Blazor) backed by unit tests, Testcontainers MySQL integration tests, and Blazor UI tests.
